title: How does a grilling or handoff endpoint preserve the owner’s intended scope?
question: How does a grilling or handoff endpoint preserve the owner’s intended scope?
answer:
BPR-R1: The prior chat 'failed at the beginning' because it never actually started a grilling session. Had it started correctly, stopping the grilling session would have been the endpoint. The handoff should then carry the owner-authorized task and authority plus all needed context from the grilling notepad.
BPR-R3: This was a promotion and scoping handoff. The receiving chat should promote the grilling notepad into docs and Specs, using all the skills named for that process, so implementation could happen in a later step. It was not authorized to implement the promoted work in the same step.
V3-20: It authorizes the minimum complete single-repository v3 runway and preserves Kayden's owner-only promotion gate.
V3-20A: Promote the settled diary into the owning docs/spec, implement through red/green slices from refreshed integration, verify exact pushed heads, perform independent review, reconcile obsolete PR #42 after replacement proof, and open the final integration-to-main PR.
V3-20B: Merging to main, changing visibility or credentials, editing the private skills repository, importing Foundry machinery, broad guidebook or skill-catalog redesign, and claiming release without source/test/fresh-exercise proof.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: BPR-R1, BPR-R3, V3-20, V3-20A, V3-20B (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.

expectedResult.change: BPR-R1 update workbench/skills/grilling/SKILL.md: Explicit user direction to stop or hand off ends the interview; hand-off exit composes a Markdown handoff with the exact requested job. | BPR-R1 update workbench/skills/handoff/SKILL.md: State the exact job and endpoint; mentioning make-it-so or carry cannot expand it; carry inherited authorization and notepad context. | BPR-R3 update workbench/skills/handoff/SKILL.md: Carry explicit exclusions: for 'create specifications; do not implement' the recipient authors the named specifications only. | BPR-R3 create workbench/specs/S-00A-blueprint-active-adr-and-context-map/SPEC.md: Durable record of the locked decisions (with S-00B to S-00E as the staged successors), leaving implementation to later Tasks. | V3-20 create workbench/specs/S-021-portable-workbench-v3/SPEC.md: Scope and Non-Goals limit the runway to the minimum v3 capability in LLM Workbench only; merging integration into main is a non-goal. | V3-20 update AGENTS.md (Git Rules) and templates/AGENTS.md: Only the owner merges integration into main. | V3-20A create workbench/specs/S-021-portable-workbench-v3/SPEC.md: Promoted capability with six dependency-ordered red/green tickets (TK-001..TK-006) and independent review of the exact pushed candidate. | V3-20A update workbench/specs/S-014-workbench-release-candidate/SPEC.md: Resumes its exact-head audit, status and integration-to-main promotion PR after the S-021 candidate lands. | V3-20A retire GitHub PR #42: Closed unmerged after replacement proof exists. | V3-20B create workbench/specs/S-021-portable-workbench-v3/SPEC.md: Non-Goals list each exclusion: main merge, credentials/visibility/private skills repo, Foundry machinery, full catalog or guidebook rewrite, unproven outcome claims.
